rationale: The last candle shows a sharp rejection from the session high of $70.26, with price pulling back to $69.86 on elevated volume (17,644 shares), suggesting supply absorption near the top of the range. At 83.3% of today's range with price already extended well above the 9-EMA ($68.58) and VWAP ($69.08), the risk/reward for a long entry is unfavorable, while the prior strong momentum makes a short entry equally risky without a clearer breakdown structure. The wide bid-ask spread (42.9 bps) on a relatively illiquid name adds friction that further reduces edge in either direction at this moment.
